content: Disk maintenance schedule (2026-10-01): weekly scrub Sun 03:30 (btrfs scrub start -B), weekly TRIM Sun 03:00 (/usr/libexec/feralos-weekly-trim: cryptsetup refresh --allow-discards on luks-* -> btrfs filesystem trim -a / -> clear; no luksFormat/booster changes), daily btrbk 02:00; cron paths resolved at install; logrotate 7d for new logs. OpenRC klogd FIXED via installer override /etc/init.d/klogd (vendor needs logger/syslogd replaced by vector). Harness: disk_schedule check; klogd/coverage validations unconditional. Verified dinit niri 72/72 + OpenRC minimal 48/48.

OpenRC klogd fix = installer-written override initd with no deps: dmesg snapshot + /sbin/klogd -n background, after localmount vector. TRIM on dm-crypt: runtime `cryptsetup refresh --allow-discards` toggles passthrough per-run (cryptsetup refresh supports --persistent for LUKS2 metadata too); QEMU devices make trim a no-op.

Disk/logging round verified 2026-10-01: dinit niri 72/72 (run 17-44-16Z) + OpenRC minimal 48/48 (17-48-47Z); klogd works both inits (serial: Starting klogd (vector) [ ok ]), disk_schedule + log_coverage green.

klogd-openrc package in aports (989.0.1.0): replaces="busybox-openrc" (apk refuses overwriting etc/init.d/klogd without it — found by rehearsal); ships dependency-free initd (dmesg snapshot + klogd -n -> /dev/log, after localmount vector). Installer no longer writes it at runtime (logging.go removed); OpenRC path installs the package (packages.go); boot-runlevel enablement unchanged. Harness klogd_service asserts the package marker on OpenRC. aports 2d5e05f CI green; OpenRC minimal 48/48 + dinit niri 72/72.

klogd-openrc verified: OpenRC minimal run 2026-10-01T18-14-18Z 48/48 (Installing klogd-openrc 989.0.1.0-r0, klogd [ started ], kern.log 22 lines) + dinit niri regression 72/72 (run 18-17-10Z). earlyoom confirmed configured: defaults -m10/-s10 (TERM/KILL), -r 60 report interval (default 1s), earlyoom-dinit enabled+running; Alpine conf.d/earlyoom ignored by design.
